author: New China TV
description:
A viral basketball video brought He Mingliang into the public eye, but it did little to ease the challenges he faced as a person with hearing and physical disabilities.
Then came an unexpected opportunity: para climbing. With less than a month of training, He stepped onto the national competition stage, opening the door to a future he might never have imagined. But with new possibilities come new uncertainties, and the path ahead is far from clear.
The Silent Ascent from Going Viral to Going Vertical follows He's journey from viral sensation to aspiring para climber, asking what might lie beyond the spotlight and whether this unexpected opportunity could lead to a different future.
title: Documentary | The Silent Ascent: From Going Viral to Going Vertical
